title: Adhyaya 4: Classical Duties & Dharma
summary: Canonical verses on traditional righteousness from Adhyaya 4.
ai_summary: Exposition of ethical conduct and cosmic law according to Sage Manu in Adhyaya 4.

verses.original: सत्यं ब्रूयात् प्रियं ब्रूयान्न ब्रूयात् सत्यमप्रियम् । प्रियं च नानृतं ब्रूयादेष धर्मः सनातनः ॥
verses.transliteration: satyaṁ brūyāt priyaṁ brūyānna brūyāt satyamapriyam | priyaṁ ca nānṛtaṁ brūyādeṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ||
verses.translation: Speak the truth; speak what is agreeable; do not speak an unpleasant truth, nor speak an agreeable untruth — this is the eternal Dharma.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The golden rule of righteous communication: truth must be spoken with love, and pleasantness must never sacrifice integrity.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Speak the truth; speak what is agreeable; do not speak an unpleasant truth, nor speak an agreeable untruth — this is the eternal Dharma.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 4: The golden rule of righteous communication: truth must be spoken with love, and pleasantness must never sacrifice integrity.

verses.original: धर्मं शनैः संचिनुयाद्वल्मीकमिव पुत्तिकाः । परलोकसहायार्थं सर्वभूतान्यपीडयन् ॥
verses.transliteration: dharmaṁ śanaiḥ saṁcinuyādvalmīkamiva puttikāḥ | paralokasahāyārthaṁ sarvabhūtānyapīḍayan ||
verses.translation: Gradually accumulate merit and virtue, like ants building an ant-hill, without causing pain to any living being, for one's support in the world beyond.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: Non-injury (Ahimsa) is the essential foundation for gathering spiritual virtue.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Gradually accumulate merit and virtue, like ants building an ant-hill, without causing pain to any living being, for one's support in the world beyond.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 4: Non-injury (Ahimsa) is the essential foundation for gathering spiritual virtue.
